"You stand in a cell over the body of a Grineer you just killed. You can't stop thinking about his dying words, 'You'll never find the Lotus.'"
"You glance at the open cell door. What's your next move?"

I want to go out into the hall.

"You carefully sneak out of the cell. To your right is a large door, the exit. It is open just a crack. You hear more Grineer guards mulling about on the other side. To your left the dungeon hall continues but it is too dark to see."
"You search the guards body again but find nothing more of value. You think about eating the moldy biscuit until a catch a whiff of it and quickly reconsider. "
"You feel around the guards body for anything of value. There's nothing but a flint-stone and a moldy bisquit. You take the flint."

"You close the door and wait for help, but no helps arrive. Instead the guards come and they get really mad because you weren't supposed to kill their friend and so they do all sorts of horrible and mean things to you until you die a terrible, senseless death."
"You can see a little further into the dungeon now. What do you do?"
"A torch hangs on the wall. What do you do?"
What happens if I try to go out the exit?
"You try to open door gently but it creaks so loudly that the guards are instantly alerted to your escape attempt. They are not impressed with what you did to their commrade."
"You pull the torch off the wall"
"A little voice in the back of your mind says 'hey, assclown, this is your last shot. The guard still has nothing good on him. Quit dicking around."
"You take the torch, hoping the flame does not go out. You walk down the corridor. You pass empty cells, each one as barren as the last."
"You fumble into the darkness searching for... something... with each step you feel more lost. Suddenly you trip over a ledge."
"Your death is swift, but not swift enough to be painless. It hurts, lots."
"An ancient god has had enough of your shit. You have been struck by lightning. You are dead. The end."

"As you carefully creep toward the end of the hall, your torch light begins to reveal a pit of darkness in front of you. You come to stand over a cistern. Pearing down you cannot see the bottom. If not for the torch you surely would have fallen to your doom."
"You are falling. You have just enough time to regret not bringing a light source with you before you hit the ground with a splat."
"You look around and notice a a bunch of rotten boards barricading something."
